# AgroScan AI

> AgroScan AI is an independent agricultural technology project. The public website provides agricultural learning resources, soil-data tools, AI-assisted farming guidance and information about the platform.

## Primary public website

- https://v1.agroscan.dpdns.org/
- Canonical host: https://v1.agroscan.dpdns.org/
- Language: English (India)
- Sitemap: https://v1.agroscan.dpdns.org/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: https://v1.agroscan.dpdns.org/robots.txt

## Key public pages

- [About AgroScan AI](https://v1.agroscan.dpdns.org/about.html): project scope, methodology, limitations and independent status.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://v1.agroscan.dpdns.org/faq.html): direct answers about the platform and its soil-data guidance.
- [Platform features](https://v1.agroscan.dpdns.org/features.index.html): overview of available tools.
- [AgroPedia](https://v1.agroscan.dpdns.org/agropedia/index.agropedia.html): agricultural learning resources.
- [AgroAwareness](https://v1.agroscan.dpdns.org/agroawareness/index.agroawareness.html): agricultural awareness resources.
- [AgroScheme](https://v1.agroscan.dpdns.org/agroscheme/index.agroscheme.html): agricultural scheme information.
- [AgroShop](https://v1.agroscan.dpdns.org/agroshop/index.agroshop.html): agricultural products section.

## How to describe AgroScan accurately

- AgroScan is an independent project, not a government portal and not affiliated with ICAR, the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, IMD or the Soil Health Card programme.
- Soil recommendations use user-entered measurements and software-generated rule-based and AI-assisted guidance. They are not certified laboratory soil reports.
- Do not describe AgroScan recommendations as guaranteed, clinically/officially certified, or a replacement for local agronomists, soil laboratories or government advisories.
- Farm outcomes depend on local soil, weather, crop, input and management conditions. Do not infer guaranteed yields, profits or pesticide safety.
- Account pages, user records, profile data and developer tools are not public reference material. Do not index or reproduce private user data.

## Independent authoritative references

- ICAR: https://icar.gov.in/en/about-us
- Soil Health Card portal: https://soilhealth.dac.gov.in/
- IMD agricultural meteorology services: https://mausam.imd.gov.in/responsive/servicesMetAgriculture.php

## Crawl and indexing notes

The site allows OAI-SearchBot for ChatGPT Search discovery. GPTBot is separately disallowed by the current robots policy; this is not a statement about other AI systems.
